listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray turns day into night - in a charming, sensual way! Experience precious moments with the perfume that emphasises your femininity and brings out your mysterious side. Bronze Goddess Nuit is your reliable companion for romantic dinners under the stars as well as for a break in the middle of the day. Magical and enchanting Spicy, even slightly smoky, but still exuding pure femininity with a hint of flowers: this is how the Eau de Parfum Spray by Estée Lauder can be aptly described. The mystical side of this exquisite fragrance is omnipresent and transports you to a world full of magic. Experience marvellous sunsets or the view of the stars, even if only during a short dream journey in everyday life. The fragrance nuances of Bronze Goddess Nuit are very versatile and start with sweet bergamot and exotic ylang-ylang. A peppery accord keeps the perfume interesting and exciting. A bouquet of flowers then unfolds, accompanied by coconut, which reminds you of faraway destinations in places like the Caribbean. Enjoy your personal everyday time-out again and again - with the fragrance from Estée Lauder!

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum brings a summery fragrance experience directly into everyday life. The fragrance is presented in an elegant glass bottle with a rose gold colour gradient and a metallic, grooved cap. The warm composition envelops the body with a harmonious blend of sunny notes that immediately evoke carefree holidays. Thanks to the fine formulation as an eau de parfum, the aroma is long-lasting and reliably accompanies you throughout the day. A quick spray in the morning is enough to create a pleasant and present aura, allowing for economical consumption. This makes the perfume an uncomplicated companion for a variety of situations, whether at work, in your free time or for a special occasion in the evening. The carefully coordinated fragrance accords blend gently with each other and leave an elegant, warm impression. Anyone wearing this fragrance will enjoy a carefree olfactory signature that skilfully captures the feeling of warm sunshine and subtly emphasises personal charisma. Long-lasting fragrance experience thanks to the concentrated formulation as an eau de parfum Warm, summery fragrance composition for a daily holiday feeling Versatile use for leisure, work and evening occasions Easy and economical application thanks to the fine spray head

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The seductive warmth of sun-kissed skin, the refreshing sea breeze and the interplay of fruity and floral notes of lush nature. Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue embodies the carefree mood of a day accompanied by the soothing sound of the waves gently lapping against the rocks of Capri. THE DESIGN Simple sophistication down to the smallest detail: the bottle with its soft contours has a matt finish and elegant silver-coloured elements. It is crowned by an enamelled, sky-blue cap, the design of which is inspired by the traditional ceramics of the Amalfi Coast, enhanced by the characteristic DG monogram.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum brings a refreshing fragrance composition to everyday life. A minimalist glass bottle with a light blue cap and subtle gold details encases the fine essence. Sparkling citrus notes unfold immediately after spraying and can create an invigorating feeling for the start of the day. Fruity accents combine harmoniously with delicate floral aromas, giving the fragrance a pleasant lightness. This balanced blend is ideal for warm days or everyday use in the office, as it remains present without being overpowering. The woody base note rounds off the fragrance experience and leaves a soft, warm presence on the skin. A few sprays on pulse points such as the wrists or neck are enough to optimally unfold the aromas. The creation discreetly accompanies you through various everyday situations and conveys a lasting feeling of freshness. Refreshing fragrance composition with sparkling citrus notes and delicate floral aromas Versatile use for everyday office life and warm summer days Woody base note for a soft, warm presence on the skin Easy to use thanks to targeted spraying on the pulse points Minimalist glass bottle with elegant blue and gold details

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue pour homme Eau de Parfum Spray Capri in Love 50 ml
listings.description: A breath of salty sea air and the warm, golden light of Capri invite you to dream. Light Blue Capri In Love Pour Homme Eau de Parfum unfolds in a fascinating and flattering way, opening with the spicy freshness of black pepper. The heart reveals the lively, green essence of the Capri fig, while precious patchouli lends the fragrance depth and a magnetic elegance, symbolising the Mediterranean flair of the island. THE DESIGN The bottle with its flowing contours and enamelled cap is adorned with ornate patterns reminiscent of Capri's traditional blue majolica tiles, a design that reflects the beauty of the island in every detail.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray My Devotion 30 ml
listings.description: With Dolce&Gabbana My Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense, you will discover a harmonious fragrance composition that enriches your everyday life with floral, fruity notes. The top note of delicate pear blossom and blackcurrant opens the experience and offers you a refreshing moment to start the day. Orange blossom and peony then unfold their floral accents, elegantly emphasising your charisma for every occasion. The base of ambroxan, warm Madagascar vanilla and amber rounds off the creation and leaves a long-lasting, gourmand presence on the skin that will accompany you reliably into the evening. Master perfumer Olivier Cresp created this intense fragrance as an expression of authenticity, making it ideal to wear as your daily signature perfume. This composition is encased in a shiny pink bottle with an ornate golden heart emblem. Floral-fruity gourmand fragrance for a long-lasting presence in everyday life Refreshing opening with pear blossom and blackcurrant Elegant heart notes of orange blossom and peony Warm base with Madagascar vanilla, ambroxan and amber Created by master perfumer Olivier Cresp for everyday use

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: This eau de parfum, launched in 2015, is a deeper and denser interpretation of the classic fragrance concept. Designed by Olivier Polge, the composition is characterised by a higher concentration of fragrance oils, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance experience. The opening is characterised by a combination of grapefruit, coriander and basil, which conveys an aromatic yet elegant freshness. As the fragrance progresses, a spicy heart unfolds, in which striking notes of ginger and cardamom meet the subtle nuance of orange blossom. These elements finally merge into a persistent base characterised by accords of tobacco, amber and cedar wood, giving the perfume its woody character. The design of the bottle emphasises the value of the contents: A heavy, rectangular glass body reveals the brown liquid and is topped with a colour-coordinated, dark brown cap. The clear, geometric lines are only accentuated by a silver inscription on the front, which completes the overall aesthetic look. Fragrance: Warm and spicy with woody and aromatic elements Head note: A fresh blend of grapefruit, coriander and basil. Heart note: Spicy accents of ginger and cardamom as well as orange blossom. Base note: Deep accords of tobacco, amber and cedarwood. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with brown contents and dark brown cap.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Only One captures the essence of elegant, mesmerising femininity. This composition impresses with a modern combination of violet and coffee notes. Like the woman it represents, the fragrance is a complex interplay of contrasts. This beguiling creation draws its special charm from the unexpected mocha violet note. The violet opens up the fragrance and combines with subtle notes of bergamot to create a lively, fresh and juicy bouquet. A harmonious whole emerges in the heart note with the fusion of seductive notes of rich coffee and charming iris, while the base delicately envelops the senses with a coating of vanilla and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue pour homme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum Spray offers an intense fragrance composition that transports you to the vast hilly landscapes of Tuscany. The creation is presented in a clear glass bottle with a light blue lid and subtle gold-coloured accents. The fine atomiser allows you to apply the perfume precisely and evenly to the desired areas of skin. Immediately after application, a fresh note of Sicilian lemon unfolds, providing a pleasant start to the day in the morning. Later on, the fruity nuances of fig combine with the warm, earthy character of Virginian cedarwood to create a well-rounded overall picture. This balanced combination gives you an aura of presence that is suitable for both business and leisure. As this is a highly concentrated eau de parfum, you benefit from a long-lasting fragrance that will reliably accompany you for many hours and makes constant refreshing unnecessary. Intense eau de parfum for a long-lasting fragrance presence without frequent re-spraying Fine atomiser enables precise and even application to the skin Fresh top note of Sicilian lemon supports a pleasant start to the day Warm base of cedar wood and fig emphasises a self-confident radiance in everyday life

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is an exclusive and extraordinary fragrance that is noble, graceful and luxurious . The name translates as "The Empress". There is therefore no doubt that this is an extravagant perfume that envelops women in a distinguished, aristocratic aura . Fruity-sweet notes meet fresh and floral influences and give every woman a romantic, seductive and extremely attractive aura. A touch of decadence is used here as a playful stylistic device. Modern, decadent and elegant - a fragrance with an aristocratic signature Fruity notes of redcurrant, kiwi and rhubarb open the unmistakable fragrance composition in the top note. The heart note is perfectly complemented by the sounds of pink cyclamen and watermelon. The Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is rounded off in the base with accords of grapefruit wood, musk and sandalwood. This is where the fragrance gains its depth and intensity. The perfume was launched back in 2009 and released in a new edition in 2020. Due to its lightness , L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is particularly effective in the warmer seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: K by Dolce&Gabbana A new era of masculinity . In an instant, the warm, cosy embrace of K by Dolce & Gabbana evokes the Italian countryside and the Mediterranean midday sun, evoking the fresh, earthy scent of the wooded Tuscan hills. The fragrance invigorates the senses with an intense combination of the citrus freshness of blood orange and Sicilian lime, amber accents of clary sage, sparkling geranium and energising lavender, a fresh hint of juniper berry and a spark of fiery allspice essence. Then a sensual cedarwood note emerges, merging with earthy vetiver before giving way to the sweet spice of patchouli to enhance the intrinsic charisma of the modern king that wears K by Dolce&Gabbana .

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The One Eau de Parfum Intense is a fascinating reinterpretation of the well-known classic. Perfumer Quentin Bisch is responsible for this composition, which combines tried-and-tested elements with new accents. Bright notes of spicy pink pepper meet the freshness of mandarin and the fruitiness of blackcurrant in the opening. At the centre of the creation is a striking jasmine note that gives the fragrance a distinct floral character. This heart note transitions gently into a persistent base. Here, creamy vanilla and rich amber accords come together to create a harmonious finish. This combination creates an aura of opulence and warmth that remains perceptible for several hours. The high-quality content is also reflected visually. A heavy, rectangular bottle made of amber-coloured glass with clear, rounded edges houses the golden liquid. A wide, shiny metallic cap in a gold tone rounds off the design harmoniously. Black letters on the front provide a clear contrast to the warm colour of the glass and underline the modern elegance of the presentation. The eau de parfum is available in different quantities, such as 50 ml or 100 ml, to suit different needs. Intense reinterpretation of the classic fragrance by Quentin Bisch Composition of pink pepper, jasmine, vanilla and amber Rectangular amber-coloured glass bottle with gold accents Available in different sizes such as 50 ml and 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a world of passion and elegance with the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This intensified version of the popular Devotion fragrance is a tribute to the timeless beauty and power of love. With its unique fragrance composition, this perfume takes you on a sensual journey. Intense perfume for intense moments The fragrance profile opens with an aromatic top note of hazelnut, which immediately captivates your senses. The floral elegance of orange blossom unfolds at the heart of the perfume, lending the fragrance a delicate, feminine note. The base note rounds off the composition with warm, sweet vanilla, which ensures a long-lasting, seductive fragrance. The Eau de Parfum Intense Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is characterised by its particularly concentrated formulation, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance. The elegant bottle with its characteristic golden cap is not only a container for the precious fragrance, but also a real piece of jewellery for your dressing table. To optimise the fragrance, it is recommended to apply the perfume to pulse points such as the wrists, neck and décolleté. It is particularly suitable for special occasions and evening events, but also gives you an aura of luxury and sophistication in everyday life. Let yourself be enchanted by the unique combination of nutty, floral and sweet notes. Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a perfume - it is an expression of devotion and elegance that accompanies you throughout the day and emphasises your individual personality.
